nodes.title: Unemployment relief you probably don't know exists
nodes.summary: Half your average daily wage, for up to 90 days. Once in a lifetime.
nodes.body: The Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana pays relief at 50% of average per-day earnings for up to 90 days, once in a lifetime, to insured persons under the ESI Act. It became payable after 30 days of unemployment rather than 90, and the claim goes directly to the ESIC branch office — it does not have to be routed through your last employer. Payment goes straight to your bank account. The scheme runs to 30 June 2027. Eligibility depends on how long you were insured and how many days you contributed, and those conditions have been relaxed more than once, so check the current rule on esic.gov.in before assuming you don't qualify.
documents: Bank details, or a cancelled cheque for the Branch Manager to authenticate

warnings.text: Your bank details must already be in the ESIC database, or the Branch Manager must authenticate them against a cancelled cheque or passbook in your name.

nodes.title: Withdraw up to 75% of your PF
nodes.summary: Available after one month of unemployment.
nodes.body: After one month of unemployment you can withdraw up to 75% of your total PF balance — your contribution, the employer's contribution and interest on both. The rule for the remaining 25% changed recently and sources disagree on the current waiting period, so check EPFO before planning around it.

warnings.text: The timing for the remaining 25% was changed in late 2025. Confirm the current rule with EPFO.

nodes.title: Check your employer approved your KYC before you claim
nodes.summary: The most common cause of rejection in 2026 is not your mistake.
nodes.body: Under the current EPFO system, auto-settlement only works where the employer has digitally approved your KYC on the EPFO portal. If your Aadhaar, PAN or bank account is not digitally approved by them, the claim is rejected automatically, with no human review. Check this before you file, not after. EPFO's own figures put the combined return and rejection rate for claims at 21.59%.

warnings.text: An unapproved KYC means automatic rejection with no human review.
